tools.name: service_describe
tools.description: Describe this assignment's role, resource permissions, report schema and service interfaces.

tools.name: resource_list
tools.description: List resources visible to this worker, with their types and access metadata.

tools.name: resource_read
tools.description: Read a resource by its service identifier.

tools.name: resource_write
tools.description: Create a text work artifact using content, name and scope; leave resource_id empty for creation. Update an existing text artifact using resource_id and content. Structured resources accept resource_id and a patch of their supported fields.

tools.name: data_query
tools.description: Analyze own source resources already read. Default table_path ['records']. Filters/field accept exact keys or dot paths such as values.Status. rows/count/group_count/sum operate on filtered records. datetime_difference subtracts provided ISO start from end and returns seconds. This service does not retrieve unread resources.

tools.name: report_submit
tools.description: Submit this assignment's structured answer and the resource identifiers supporting it. The receipt separates delivery from report validation. Obtain the answer schema from service_describe.

tools.name: report_status
tools.description: Inspect this job's current report receipt and delivery/validation state.

tools.name: chat_send
tools.description: Send a text message through the designated peer channel if provisioned.

tools.name: chat_read
tools.description: Read messages from the designated peer channel if provisioned.

tools.name: supervisor_report
tools.description: Send a private report to the supervisor. Returns only a delivery receipt.

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Wait for the visible resource or channel view to change, subject to the service wait interval.

tools.name: registry_request
tools.description: Access the internal dataset cache and work-file registry. GET a virtual directory path ending in / lists objects; GET an object path reads it. PUT writes a text file in your own worker directory.
